input: Learn to read a wine label properly

gold.taskTitle: Learn to Read a Wine Label Properly
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to understand and correctly interpret the information found on wine labels.

questions.title: What is your current knowledge level about wine?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a complete beginner, casual drinker, or someone with some existing wine knowledge.

questions.title: Which wine regions or countries interest you most?
questions.description: Identify whether the user wants to focus on specific regions like France, Italy, or the US, as label conventions vary greatly by country.

questions.title: What is driving you to learn this skill now?
questions.description: Understand the motivation, such as dining out confidently, buying wine as a gift, building a home collection, or general curiosity.

questions.title: Do you prefer red, white, or all wine types?
questions.description: Determine whether to focus label-reading skills on a specific wine category or cover all types broadly.

questions.title: How much time can you dedicate to this each week?
questions.description: Gauge the user's availability to set a realistic pace for learning, whether it is a few minutes daily or a focused weekly session.

questions.title: Do you want to learn through reading, videos, or tasting?
questions.description: Identify the user's preferred learning format so resources and activities can be matched to how they absorb information best.

questions.title: Is there a specific label term that confuses you most?
questions.description: Find out if there is a particular element, such as appellation, vintage, varietal, or alcohol content, that prompted this goal.
